s1.syndrome_frame: A subacute onset of a painful breast mass with associated imaging and histopathological findings
salient_findings: Palpable mass in the upper quadrant of the left breast
Ill-defined, deep retroareolar spiculated lesion on breast MRI
Cohesive nests of neoplastic epithelial cells within a dense lymphoid infiltrate on excisional biopsy
key_facts: One-month history of burning sensation and discomfort in the left breast
No fever or systemic symptoms
Hypertension and a remote history of hemorrhoidectomy, dilation and curettage, colonoscopy, and gastroscopy
Heavy smoker
3 × 3 cm palpable mass in the upper quadrant of the left breast
No axillary or supraclavicular lymphadenopathy
Unremarkable routine blood tests, chest radiograph, and ECG
Breast MRI showed an ill-defined, deep retroareolar spiculated lesion measuring 3 × 1.5 cm
Early enhancement peak and associated architectural distortion on breast MRI
No axillary lymphadenopathy or skin thickening on breast MRI
Excisional biopsy showed breast tissue containing cohesive nests of neoplastic epithelial cells
Neoplastic epithelial cells positive for cytokeratin AE1/E3 and negative for estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and HER2/neu

per_call: Squamous cell carcinoma of the breast

shortlist.label: Medullary carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Triple-negative breast cancer with lymphoid infiltrate and poor prognosis

shortlist.label: Lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma of the breast
shortlist.why_kept: Similar histological features and aggressive nature

shortlist.label: Triple-negative breast cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Lack of estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and HER2/neu expression

shortlist.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid onset and aggressive nature, although no skin changes were noted

shortlist.label: Metaplastic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive subtype with variable histology, including lymphoid infiltrate

raw.rationale: The presence of a palpable mass, ill-defined spiculated lesion on breast MRI with early enhancement peak and architectural distortion, and the histological findings of cohesive nests of neoplastic epithelial cells within a dense lymphoid infiltrate, along with the immunohistochemical staining profile, are consistent with medullary carcinoma, a subtype of triple-negative breast cancer.

rejected.label: Lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma of the breast
rejected.why: While it shares some histological similarities, the clinical and radiological presentation is more consistent with medullary carcinoma.

rejected.label: Triple-negative breast cancer
rejected.why: Too broad, as medullary carcinoma is a specific subtype of triple-negative breast cancer that better explains the lymphoid infiltrate and specific imaging findings.

rejected.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
rejected.why: Lack of skin changes, fever, or systemic symptoms, which are typical of inflammatory breast cancer.

rejected.label: Metaplastic carcinoma
rejected.why: The histological description does not mention the characteristic metaplastic elements, such as squamous or mesenchymal differentiation, seen in metaplastic carcinoma.
